answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 3492 Country: United States of America Title: I have a question regarding my personal problems. Long ago I used to masturbate , But Alhumdulillah ,with the grace of Allah S.W.T i was able to overcome it and have left that filthy habit for around more than 3 -3.5 years. But now from around past 2 or more years, I face a problem during sleeping. While sleeping I start moving against the bedding (as someone would move while doing intercourse) I don't know when do i start moving during my sleep and by the time I gain my actual consciousness I am already moving against the bedding and about to eject. Sometimes when i gain my consciousness .. i am able to stop this moving , thereby preventing any ejection..and sometimes I just cant do it since the ejection is just about to take place.... It gives me the same feeling as masturbating when i move ..... BUT I DON'T WANT TO MASTURBATE , NEITHER I WANT TO DO THIS FILTHY THING DURING MY SLEEP OR ANYTIME... Answer ID: 3492 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 403/358=D) Human being is not answerable for acts he commits in a state of sleeping. But, the thought that occupy ones mind in awakening state they are reflected in sleeps. Therefore, first of all you should shun from such thoughts and promise not to let them in, and in case such thoughts creep in you should repent to Allah and cast away it from your mind. Pray the below dua with Ayatul Kursi : أ عوذ بکلمات اللہ التامات من غضبہ و عقابہ و شر عبادہ و من ھمزات الشیاطین و أن یحضرون And, recite isteghfar ( استغفار ) and change the side in case such thought comes in your mind while going to sleep. Discard such thinking when you find yourself doing the movement. Try to overcome this habit, in-sha-Allah this it will go away. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
